highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.157 updates to Skia m157 with raster, glyph and GPU rendering corrections.
highlights_body: The line also makes LibraryImport calling conventions explicit. Later collected fixes improve reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and affected Vulkan device-loss cleanup without changing managed API signatures.

bullets.lead: Skia m157 with unchanged managed signatures
bullets.detail: Updates the native renderer to milestone 157 while retaining the existing binding surface and glyph-bounds guard. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200; native HarfBuzz remains 14.4.0.

bullets.lead: Correct raster bounds and GPU transfers
bullets.detail: Fixes convex antialiased path overflow across clip gaps, Ganesh device-space bounds and coverage-mask clamping, Graphite clip-key packing and wedge inflation, and alpha-to-RGBx readback stride. Also initializes Vulkan render-pass pointers correctly.
Validates direct-mask Slug data during deserialization and drawing, and corrects unsupported fractional replay so unsuitable glyph data does not bypass rendering constraints.

Corrects oversized square caps on zero-length hairlines under reflected transforms and guards non-finite cap calculations. Rounds Ganesh atlas indices to avoid selecting the wrong texture for ordinary and LCD text.

Adds a 1 ms delay on affected Ganesh and Graphite device-loss cleanup paths for ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 up to, but not including, 56. The integration review did not specifically establish affected physical-device behavior.

Generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl, matching DllImport and delegate paths across SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp. This addresses an ABI mismatch relevant to Windows x86; runtime verification of the reported optimized-call stack growth remains outstanding.

preview_summaries.v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1: Preview 1 introduces Skia m157, corrects raster and GPU readback behavior, and validates glyph replay. It also makes LibraryImport declarations explicitly cdecl; HarfBuzzSharp's 14.4.0.200 package revision retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp's generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly specify cdecl, matching the existing import and delegate conventions. Package revision 14.4.0.200 does not upgrade the native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine.

v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.headline: Preview 1 introduces Skia m157 with raster, glyph-replay and Graphite readback corrections.
v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1.body: Generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl. HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.200 without changing the native HarfBuzz version.
